edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from the dispute that is the subject of this Agreement (the “Dispute”).

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [amount to be agreed] (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten business days after the parties execute this Agreement, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising from the Dispute. This release does not extend to claims unrelated to the Dispute or rights to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by law, regulation, or legal process; reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement; or made to that party’s professional advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations.
